# Journals at University of Victoria

> Open-access academic publishing platform hosting peer-reviewed journals focused on global studies and contemporary international issues.

Journals.uvic.ca is the University of Victoria's academic journal hosting service, supporting scholarly research and open-access publication. The platform is rooted on the traditional territories of the Lekwungen, Songhees, Esquimalt, and WSÁNEĆ peoples of Vancouver Island.

## Key Topics

- Borders in Globalization Review
- Open-access publishing
- Academic journals
- Global studies

## Featured Journals

- [Borders in Globalization Review](https://journals.uvic.ca/index.php/bigreview): Open-access academic journal exploring borders and globalization in the 21st century
